title: Cut over only after replacement authentication and CRM persistence pass
description: Given the new app passes anonymous401, nonmember403, Google-admin access and real create/move/note/reload/conflict checks, when an explicitly approved DNS change uses the exact verified Amplify target for prospectus.anth.us, then clients reach the replacement with a documented rollback while the old instance and data remain available. No deletion or DNS cutover before acceptance; the separate marketing site is not migrated by this story.
